en.description: Composable starter: landing, Google sign-in, dashboard, records grid and map — configured, not generated.

landing.headline: One configuration. A working prototype.
landing.subheadline: Explore the landing, sign in, and try a records workflow. Each chapter is an existing component, filled with the same content that powers search and AI discovery.

features.title: Fifteen colour palettes
features.description: Fifteen two-colour pairs; WCAG AA contrast is enforced at build time.

features.title: Config-driven patterns
features.description: Landing, auth, dashboard, CRUD grid, map — enabled by presence in prototype.config.json.

features.title: Static export
features.description: Next.js 16 builds to static HTML. Deploy anywhere — Firebase, Vercel, a CDN.

faq.heading: What should you know before trying it?

items.question: Is this generated code?
items.answer: No. The prototype uses existing components enabled by a JSON configuration.

items.question: Where do the records live?
items.answer: Signed-in visitors work with their own records in a private Firestore sandbox.

items.question: Does the page work on a phone?
items.answer: Yes. Phones show the same chapters as a scrolling document. Desktop supports a sticky story stage.
